description: A chat prompt, and a position inside one of its turns. The `chat` column holds a list of {'role', 'content'} messages rather than a string, so the run renders it through the checkpoint's own chat template and records where each turn landed; a position may then name a role's messages the way it names a column's text, each message an occurrence. `blanked` zeroes, and reads, the last token of the SECOND user message — `{'scope': {'turn': 'user', 'occurrence': 1}, 'index': -1}`: the conversation has two, and occurrence 0, the default, would be the first, the same rule a column's text that occurs twice gets. The template's control tokens are between the turns and in none of them, so the position is the question's own last token and not `[/INST]`.
